{{Hatnote|For the later Legacy Virtual book that introduced [[Mission]]s, see [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]]. For the current tournament book, see [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]].}}
[[File:AR171-cover.png|thumb|right|280px|Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1 cover]]

The '''Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1''' is the [[Players Committee]] consolidated rules book for late [[Virtual Original]] play. [[Charles Sonnenburg]] signed it as Rules Advocate.<ref name="ar171">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071024151250/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/AR1.7.1.pdf AR1.7.1.pdf], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 24 October 2007; PDF created 6 July 2007). Wiki copy: [[:File:AR-version-1-7-1.pdf]].</ref> The PDF is dated 6 July 2007. The committee hosted it at swccgpc.com by 24 October 2007.<ref name="ar171" />

The book states that it is the official rulebook for Star Wars CCG and replaces all previous rulebooks and rulings.<ref name="ar171" /> It does not introduce the [[Mission]] card type; that change is in [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]].

On 6 July 2009 and 4 September 2009 the Players Committee rules page linked <code>Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf</code> as the rules document then in force.<ref name="pcrules2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102757/http://www.starwarsccg.org/rules/ Rules], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 6 July 2009)</ref><ref name="pcrules2009b">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090904221755/http://www.starwarsccg.org/rules/ Rules], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 4 September 2009)</ref> The PDF at that path matches the July 2007 file.<ref name="ar171org">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf AR1.7.1.pdf], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 16 August 2009)</ref>

A later identical copy is hosted at karcianki.pl.<ref name="karcianki">[http://karcianki.pl/files/sw/Advanced%20Rulebook.pdf Advanced Rulebook.pdf], karcianki.pl. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160802193427/http://karcianki.pl/files/sw/Advanced%20Rulebook.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Prior documents ==

Until this book, Original Virtual play used the Decipher [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Rulebook 2.0]], [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]], [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]] (29 January 2002), and the January 2003 [[Players Committee Rules Supplement (2003)|Players Committee Rules Supplement]].

== Current-rulings sheets ==

The committee posted short Appendix F / identifying-cards sheets after the July 2007 book, including ARF0709 (17 September 2007) and ARF0803 (16 March 2008).<ref name="arf0709">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144245/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/ARF0709.pdf ARF0709.pdf], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 26 October 2007)</ref><ref name="arf0803">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080509132511/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/AR/ARF0803.pdf ARF0803.pdf], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 9 May 2008)</ref>
